families.expected_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', bookings.check_in) AS check_in_month, COUNT(*) AS booking_count FROM samples.wanderbricks.bookings AS bookings GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', bookings.check_in) ORDER BY check_in_month

prompts.text: How many bookings are there by check-in month?
Show monthly booking count using the check-in date.
Trend booking volume by month of check-in.
For each check-in month, count the bookings.

families.intent: Sum booked value by check-in month without calling it revenue.
families.expected_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', bookings.check_in) AS check_in_month, SUM(bookings.total_amount) AS gross_booked_value FROM samples.wanderbricks.bookings AS bookings GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', bookings.check_in) ORDER BY check_in_month

prompts.text: What is gross booked value by check-in month?
Show GBV for each check-in month.
Trend booking value by month using the check-in date.
Sum the total value of bookings for every check-in month.

families.intent: Count bookings by their recorded status.
families.expected_sql: SELECT bookings.status, COUNT(*) AS booking_count FROM samples.wanderbricks.bookings AS bookings GROUP BY bookings.status ORDER BY booking_count DESC, bookings.status

prompts.text: How many bookings are in each status?
Break down booking volume by status.
Count bookings for every booking status.
What is the booking status mix by count?

families.intent: Rank the top 20 properties by booked value without calling it revenue.
families.expected_sql: SELECT properties.property_id, properties.title AS property_title, SUM(bookings.total_amount) AS gross_booked_value FROM samples.wanderbricks.bookings AS bookings JOIN samples.wanderbricks.properties AS properties ON bookings.property_id = properties.property_id GROUP BY properties.property_id, properties.title ORDER BY gross_booked_value DESC, properties.property_id LIMIT 20

prompts.text: Rank the top 20 properties by gross booked value.
Show the 20 leading listings by GBV.
Which 20 properties have the greatest booking value?
Sum booking value by property and return the top 20.

families.intent: Calculate average booked nights by property type.
families.expected_sql: SELECT properties.property_type, AVG(DATEDIFF(bookings.check_out, bookings.check_in)) AS average_stay_nights FROM samples.wanderbricks.bookings AS bookings JOIN samples.wanderbricks.properties AS properties ON bookings.property_id = properties.property_id GROUP BY properties.property_type ORDER BY average_stay_nights DESC, properties.property_type

prompts.text: What is average stay length in nights by property type?
Compare average nights booked across property types.
For each property type, average the days between check-in and check-out.
Which property types have the longest average stays?

families.intent: Count distinct properties that appear in bookings, grouped by property type.
families.expected_sql: SELECT properties.property_type, COUNT(DISTINCT bookings.property_id) AS booked_property_count FROM samples.wanderbricks.bookings AS bookings JOIN samples.wanderbricks.properties AS properties ON bookings.property_id = properties.property_id GROUP BY properties.property_type ORDER BY booked_property_count DESC, properties.property_type

prompts.text: How many distinct booked properties are in each property type?
Count properties that appear in bookings, grouped by type.
Show the mix of booked listings by property category.
Group unique property IDs found in bookings by property type.
